Walk in Interview for Intern
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for Student Intern. Duration is initially
for one year or till the tenure of project whichever is earlier.
Post: Student Intern (No. of Posts: 4)
a) Eligibility: Masters in Environment Science/ Environment Engineering/Public
Health/allied Science
Students who have appeared/appearing in 2nd year exam of Master in Environment Science/
Environment Engineering/Public Health are eligible to apply
b) Internship amount: Rs. 10000/- per month (fixed)
c) Job Description:
• The candidate should have ability to converse, make presentations, write
academic papers, reports and collaborate with interdisciplinary colleagues and
researchers.
• The candidate is expected to assist with the organization of workshops,
meetings, outreach activities, and general management of the project as a
whole.
Candidate should appear for walk in interview on 30 June 2025 at 10.30 am in room no 227,
Department of Environment Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh along with Applications,
bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience, publications etc.
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/GCdsHAFaZFr2te7dA
by 29 June 2025 and before appearing for interview. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the
interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency
will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator
E-mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
